pose is to verify the efficiency of the PCA plus kernel FDA method. The results that  indicate the time consumed are shown in Tab. 3. From Tab. 3, it is seen that the proposed method is competitive with kernel FDA. The computation time is different with the different numbers of PCs reserved in PCA. The time consumed becomes longer with the increase of PCs. Although the entire time consumed owith PCA plus KFDA is longer than PCA, it is much less than that for the kernel FDA method alone. The results show that if one chooses the appropriate number of $\mathsf{P C}s,$ then the proposed method is more preferable for real-time process monitoring and fault diagnosis.
